The quotes are ARM evidence -- they identify which cohort a measurement came from ('MPTP-induced weight loss', 'normoglycaemic POMC-cre mice') -- and not absence evidence. A009 and A011 forbid an evidence entry on a value asserting an absence, so they cannot enter condition_evidence. They are retained here as arm_evidence_quote/locator rather than dropped, because they are why the reader chose the arm and a reviewer needs them.
